channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: Letter: America is drifting away from being a nation defined by rights
item.description: Letter: When belonging becomes something that must be demonstrated rather than assumed, the meaning of citizenship becomes conditional. That should alarm us all.

item.title: Utah Gov. Spencer Cox says sports betting on Kalshi is ‘destroying lives.’ The data is on his side.
item.description: Prediction markets have created a loophole that has effectively legalized gambling in Utah. There’s plenty of research to show the downsides.

item.title: Tuesday live: Ask Salt Lake Tribune journalists your questions about Utah GOP’s effort to repeal Proposition 4
item.description: Join a YouTube livestream conversation with Salt Lake Tribune journalists on Tuesday afternoon to ask your questions about the effort to repeal Proposition 4.

item.title: ‘This right is fundamental’: Federal judges reject lawmakers’ bid to toss Utah’s new congressional maps
item.description: Three federal judges unanimously rejected the latest — and likely last — attempt by GOP lawmakers to block a new congressional map from being used in Utah's 2026 midterm elections.

item.title: Another Utah Jazz starter is out for the rest of the NBA season
item.description: Utah Jazz center Jusuf Nurkic is undergoing season-ending surgery.

item.title: Should abortions be labeled differently in Utahns’ medical records? GOP says yes, doctors say no.
item.description: The Utah lawmaker most frequently tied to abortion restrictions now wants doctors to differentiate some abortions in medical records — a move opposed by the country’s largest OB-GYN group.

item.title: From gold medals to proposals: Utah athletes steal the show at 2026 Winter Games
item.description: From backward skiing to presidential criticism, Utah Olympic athletes gave us these moments to remember at the 2026 Milan-Cortina Olympic Games.

item.title: As trial begins, Utah prosecutors argue Kouri Richins wanted ‘fresh start.’ Defense says: ‘They can’t show you that she did kill her husband.’
item.description: The Utah mother accused of killing her husband before publishing a children's book about grief is drawing national news crews, podcasters and more to the Summit County Courthouse for a five-week trial.

item.title: Utah rookie Ace Bailey isn’t who you think he is. That’s why the Jazz might have a future star.
item.description: “Just get to know him. Ace Bailey is great,” teammate Kevin Love says.

item.title: One of Utah’s highest-profile murder trials begins Monday. Here’s what you should know.
item.description: One of Utah’s most-watched murder cases heads to trial this week, drawing attention from national news outlets and true crime podcasters.
